items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: And the first time he heard me play alto, you know what he told me? He said, “man you play like a bass player, you sound like a bass player.”

ctx.x: And the saxophone was not made up like that. The timbre of the saxophone, the range of the saxophone and all of that has something to do with it. And Ornette always talked about the alto, the saxophone is in the alto clef. Ornette said man the saxophone is not supposed to be played in the treble or the bass clef, it’s supposed to be played in the alto clef.
